dialog.english: Please!

That doesn't really suit your
style, Joe.
dialog.translation:
Eso no va mucho contigo,
Joe.

dialog.english:
I guess so. All right, then...
pardon us.
What's this, pi?

You see, I have an entrance exam
next year, so I need to train
myself at competition.
dialog.translation:
Veréis, tengo un examen
de acceso el año que viene,
y debo entrenar mucho.

dialog.english:
Joe's at his weakest at the most
important times, so please.
dialog.translation:
Joe flaquea en los momentos
importantes, así que por
favor.

dialog.english:
To know your own weakness and come
to receive training is admirable,
pi.
dialog.translation:
Conocer tus debilidades y
venir a entrenar es digno
de admiración, pi.

dialog.english:
But my training is rather strict,
pi. Are you ready, pi?
dialog.translation:
Pero mi entrenamiento es
duro, pi. ¿Estás listo, pi?

dialog.english:
Yes! I have to get into medical
school!

I don't really get it, but
whatever, pi. We'll start with
physical training, pi.
dialog.translation:
No lo pillo, pero bueno, pi.
Empezaremos con
entrenamiento físico, pi.

dialog.english:
First, you'll fight with these
guys, pi!
Giving up already, Joe?

*pant*... *pant*... What's the
next training regimen, Piccolomon?

Too slow! You took far too long!
Do it one more time.

Whaaaaat?! Well... I don't really
have a lot of stamina...
dialog.translation:
¡¿Quéee?! Bueno... no tengo
mucha resistencia,
la verdad...

dialog.english:
Don't you have any special
training to improve one's
competitive focus or anything?
dialog.translation:
¿No tienes algún
entrenamiento especial para
mejorar la concentración?

dialog.english:
...All right, I'll prepare a
different training regimen. Come
this way, pi.
dialog.translation:
...Bien, prepararé un
entrenamiento distinto.
Venid por aquí, pi.

dialog.english:
Hahaha! We did it, Gomamon! This
is my specialty!

Personally, I'm not that good at
using my head...
dialog.translation:
La verdad es que no se me
da bien pensar...

dialog.english:
It doesn't really matter what kind
of training it is! I'm looking
forward to it!
dialog.translation:
¡No importa qué tipo de
entrenamiento sea! ¡Tengo
muchas ganas!

dialog.english:
Piccolomon said that we just have
to make it to the back, but...
what's there?
dialog.translation:
Piccolomon dijo que solo
hay que llegar al fondo,
pero... ¿qué habrá ahí?

dialog.english:
It's too dark, I can't see
anything...
dialog.translation:
Está muy oscuro, no veo
nada...

dialog.english:
Hm? Something's coming from the
other side.
...A Digimon?
W-what's that...?

You see, I have an entrance exam
next year, so I need to train
myself at competition.
dialog.translation:
Veréis, tengo un examen
de acceso el año que viene,
y debo entrenar mucho.

dialog.english:
Hahaha! He acts just like you,
Joe!

He's saying what I said, right
down to the letter!
dialog.translation:
¡Dice lo mismo que dije,
palabra por palabra!

dialog.english:
Whaaaaat?! Well... I don't really
have a lot of stamina...
dialog.translation:
¡¿Quéee?! Bueno... no tengo
mucha resistencia,
la verdad...

dialog.english:
Don't you have any special
training to improve one's
competitive focus or anything?
dialog.translation:
¿No tienes algún
entrenamiento especial para
mejorar la concentración?

dialog.english:
...The heck? All he does is
complain...
Yup! Just like you, Joe!
Is that... me?

I came here to train myself, but
all I've done is whine...
dialog.translation:
Vine a entrenarme, pero
no he hecho más
que quejarme...

dialog.english: How embarrassing.
He's gone!

...Hey, Gomamon. Let's go back to
Piccolomon.
But what about the training?
I think that was the training.
dialog.translation: Creo que ese era el entreno.

dialog.english: Good job returning, pi!

You were the one who put that
other me in the cave, weren't you?
dialog.translation:
Fuiste tú quien puso a ese
otro yo en la cueva, ¿verdad?

dialog.english: Indeed, pi.

I came here to train, but I was 
already good at what I wanted to 
do, so I just embarrassed myself.
dialog.translation:
Vine a entrenar, pero ya
era bueno en lo que quería
hacer, y solo hice el ridículo.

dialog.english:
The fact that you've realized this
on your own means that you've
grown significantly, pi.
dialog.translation:
Que te hayas dado cuenta
tú solo significa que has
madurado mucho, pi.

dialog.english:
Hey, Piccolomon praised you!
That's great, Joe!

Prepare yourself for more rigorous
training from now on, pi. Here's
something special for you, pi.
dialog.translation:
Prepárate para un
entrenamiento más duro, pi.
Toma algo especial, pi.

dialog.english: Thanks, Piccolomon!

If you ever want to come train
again, come at any time, pi!
dialog.translation:
¡Si queréis volver a
entrenar, venid cuando
queráis, pi!

dialog.english: Okay! We'll be back for sure!
Bye-bye, Piccolomon!
~Test~
Clear episode.
